aggregation_definitions.area_mean: Cos(latitude)-weighted mean of finite cell values, with centers within the region. Count and observation-fraction means include unsampled zero cells.
aggregation_definitions.monthly_cell_mean: Sum(aod_weighted_mean * aod_count) / sum(aod_count) over valid three-hour cell means with positive product count; written means already include final clipping at zero.
aggregation_definitions.monthly_cell_mean_p999: NumPy linear percentile 99.9 over finite monthly cell means, equally weighted by cell; distinct from the pooled written three-hour cell-window percentile.
aggregation_definitions.paired_cell_mean_difference: Area mean of the difference of independently count-weighted period cell means, over cells finite in both runs; not a common-pixel or common-window comparison.
aggregation_definitions.southern_ocean: Configured latitude band south of 40 degrees S; includes land/island/Antarctic grid cells and is not an ocean-only surface mask.

scientific_acceptance.status: Plot protocol and visual inspection passed; numeric science acceptance remains separate and open.

notes: Titles, subtitles, coastlines, grid labels and colorbars are visible without clipping or overlap; the single-sensor global title prefixes were corrected and refreshed before acceptance.
All absolute AOD panels use the same full GEOSIT turbo scale with an upper extension; missing retrievals remain blank and no artificial longitude seam is visible.
Smoke-box maps show increasing west-coast high AOD from Sep 8 through Sep 10/14; values above one visibly saturate the requested capped scale rather than being removed.
MODIS versus VIIRS and NOAA-20 Deep Blue version differences have explicit subtraction labels and symmetric diverging scales. These are differences of independent period means.
The VIIRS-only negative-AOD fraction is nonzero. This diagnostic is retained as measured; the plot inspection does not assert that all negative retrievals originate in MODIS.

The remaining 120 daily previews were inspected on 20 contact sheets preserving original preview pixel dimensions; full-size followups checked MODIS September 10 global and mixed DB v2.1 September 12 smoke maps. No additional visual defects were found. All existing artifact hashes were independently verified and preserved.
